title: Operations with Integers
preview: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide integers — and apply integer operations to real-world contexts.
description: Indiana standards 7.NS.1–4. Students extend whole-number operations to signed integers and reason about absolute value, opposites, and sign rules.

sections.label: 3-1 Adding Integers
sections.description: Show on a number line that a number and its opposite have a sum of 0; sums of rational numbers in real contexts.

sections.label: 3-2 Subtracting Integers
sections.description: Distance between rational numbers on the number line as the absolute value of their difference.

sections.label: 3-3 Multiply Integers
sections.description: Properties of operations (distributive) leading to rules for multiplying signed numbers.

sections.label: 3-4 Divide Integers
sections.description: Explain that −(p/q) = (−p)/q = p/(−q) for all nonzero integers.

sections.label: 3-5 Apply Integer Operations
sections.description: Multi-step real-world problems combining integer operations.
